content.text: Digital creators in regions like Nigeria and Venezuela often face financial isolation, unable to use platforms like [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-20|COREMERCH guide to stripe]] and PayPal to launch their stores. COREMERCH's Stack 01 provides a robust solution, allowing you to deploy a digital storefront using GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. This guide walks you through [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-google-apps-script-19|Everything You]]-you-need-know-about-crypto-payment-gateways-14|everything]] you need to get your store live, ensuring you can accept crypto payments seamlessly and maintain full ownership of your data.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment platforms often exclude creators in developing regions, leaving them without viable options to monetize their digital products. COREMERCH's Stack 01 circumvents these limitations by leveraging open-source tools and crypto payments. By utilizing GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for transaction processing, you gain a fully operational store without the restrictions of conventional platforms. This infrastructure not only empowers you but also guarantees complete data sovereignty, enabling you to control every aspect of your digital commerce.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you initiate your Stack 01 deployment, ensure you have a GitHub account to host your store and access to NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script, as it will serve as the backend logic for your store. Prepare your digital products, whether they are ebooks, courses, or plugins, and gather the necessary files for upload. Additionally, ensure you have a clear understanding of your target market to tailor your offerings effectively. This preparation will streamline the deployment process and lead to a successful launch.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by deploying your GitHub Pages site, following the Sovereign Blueprint for Stack 01. Next, configure Google Apps Script to handle order logic and integrate with NOWPayments for seamless crypto payment processing. Ensure your payment gateway is set up to receive various cryptocurrencies, providing your customers with multiple options. After setting up the payment layer, test the entire flow, from product selection to payment confirmation, to ensure everything operates smoothly. This testing phase is crucial to guarantee that your customers have a frictionless experience.
Digital creators can achieve infrastructure sovereignty with COREMERCH.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is fully set up and tested, it’s time to go live. Promote your digital products through social media, email marketing, and other channels relevant to your audience. Monitor your store for the first transaction closely to ensure that the payment processing works as intended. Utilize NOWPayments' automatic webhook feature to receive instant notifications upon successful transactions, allowing you to deliver products immediately. A smooth first transaction not only confirms your setup but also instills confidence in your customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your digital store operational, focus on scaling your business. Analyze customer feedback and sales data to identify which products perform best. Consider expanding your offerings by adding more digital assets and utilizing the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for improved performance and security. This stack includes advanced configurations like SPF/DKIM/DMARC to enhance delivery rates for transactional emails. Maintain a consistent marketing strategy to drive traffic and sales, ensuring your infrastructure supports the growth of your digital commerce.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
No platform dependencies mean full control over your online store.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a GitHub account for hosting your digital store. 2. Prepare your digital products and files for upload. 3. Set up Google Apps Script to manage backend logic. 4. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 5. Deploy your GitHub Pages site according to the Sovereign Blueprint. 6. Test the payment and delivery flow thoroughly. 7. Promote your store through social channels and email marketing. 8. Monitor transactions and gather customer feedback to improve offerings.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store for free, use COREMERCH's Stack 01, which includes GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to launch your store without traditional payment processors.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, deployed within 4-6 hours, while Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages and Workers, providing enhanced features and deployed in 48 hours. Stack 02 also includes full testing before handoff.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each platform offers free hosting solutions that are perfect for deploying your digital storefront.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept various forms of digital currency. This flexibility enables your customers to choose their preferred payment method.
Is there support available after deploying my store?
Yes, upon deploying Stack 01, you receive 30 days of support, ensuring you can resolve any issues that arise as you operate your store.
